content: Expo SDK 57 ships RN 0.86.x (0.86.3), React 19.2.3, TS ~6.0.3, reanimated 4.5 + worklets 0.10; verified in local scaffold package.json and SDK 57 changelog. RN 0.86 min iOS 15.1 (scripts/cocoapods/helpers.rb), min Xcode 16.1, Android minSdk 24 (API 24). New Architecture is the only supported architecture on RN 0.8x.
